trigger_question: Should the current Typing metric add a post-setup wait?
evidence: Current Typing has 0ms extra post-setup wait. CI-comparable and exact post-editor runs show no retained-q50 stability win from adding 1s or 60s waits; the wall-clock cost is deterministic.
reopen_trigger: Only reopen if the Typing setup, helper family, trace placement, retained/throwaway policy, browser revision, or CI runner class changes enough to invalidate the existing exact-spec anchor.
required_validation: Run the exact post-editor Typing setup/run pair with 0ms and the candidate wait in randomized order, using the real reporter output and the same retained-results array.
decision_rule: Keep 0ms unless the added wait improves retained q50 stability or tail behavior by more than ordinary run-to-run spread while paying an acceptable runtime cost.

trigger_question: Does the first-character start-wait effect require changing retained q50?
evidence: First character and the first retained key are slower, but changing startup wait does not remove that shape; discarding one extra key changes median q50 across startup waits by only -0.16ms while mean and p90 move more.
reopen_trigger: Reopen if the reported statistic changes from retained q50 to first-input, mean, p90, p95, or a no-throwaway policy.
required_validation: Repeat the discard-policy table and first-three-keypress summaries under the new statistic.
decision_rule: Do not use startup wait to hide first-input cost; create or report a first-input/tail metric if that is the product question.

trigger_question: Can Typing evidence remove waits from non-Typing metrics?
evidence: Typing uses target.type()/paragraph.type() and has no extra post-setup wait by default. The five interactive Post Editor non-Typing metrics now have their own local eight-run 0ms-versus-1000ms matrix; pattern-loading metrics remain separate readiness cases.
reopen_trigger: Changing a non-Typing metric outside the five interaction metrics, or moving the interaction change from local evidence to CI behavior.
required_validation: For focus, listViewOpen, inserterOpen, inserterSearch, and inserterHover, validate 0ms against 1000ms on CI/mac/container lanes with retained counts, p50/mean/p90, failures, and two-branch runtime savings. For pattern metrics, use the pattern-specific readiness validation.
decision_rule: 0ms is the local candidate for the five interaction metrics; do not infer that result to pattern-loading or other future non-Typing metrics.

trigger_question: Does a CI image or runner change reopen the startup wait question?
current_answer: Only for absolute thresholds or when ordering changes.
evidence: The local wait curve has overlapping retained-q50 bands and the blocked 60s/0ms order control shows no monotonic wait effect; a different runner may shift absolute p50 without making wait useful.
reopen_trigger: Reopen if a compact CI lane shows retained q50 ordering, run-to-run sd, first-key behavior, or timeout/failure shape changes with startup wait.
required_validation: Run the portability validation lane with 0ms, 1s, and one long-wait control, plus environment metadata and per-run q50/sd/range.
decision_rule: Do not add wait for absolute p50 drift alone; handle drift through threshold portability.

trigger_question: Does tracing placement change the decision?
current_answer: No for the tested exact-spec placement.
evidence: Exact post-editor rows with 60s before trace, 0ms before trace, and 60s after tracing starts all stayed in the same low band.
reopen_trigger: Reopen if metrics.startTracing(), trace categories, trace snapshots, or reporter extraction move relative to the idle wait or type() call.
required_validation: Repeat before-trace and after-trace wait placements with the exact spec and confirm retained q50, first-key, and reporter summary remain in band.
decision_rule: Keep the start boundary unchanged unless a trace-placement change is intentionally redefining the metric.

trigger_question: What is the fallback if a startup wait is reintroduced?
current_answer: Treat it as a metric-definition change with explicit runtime cost.
evidence: Adding 1s to all explicit sleep sites costs 152s in the normal two-branch comparison; adding long waits scales linearly and gave no Typing retained-q50 benefit locally.
reopen_trigger: Only consider if a reopened exact-spec validation shows a clear reliability win under the new setup.
required_validation: Publish per-branch and two-branch runtime deltas, reliability deltas, and which metrics pay the wait.
decision_rule: Prefer a semantic readiness predicate or metric-specific fix over a blind fixed sleep.
